# Why Quantization Error Hits Rare Experts Harder

In Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models, quantization (compressing weights/activations to lower precision) can disproportionately harm experts that are rarely routed to. Here's why:

Explain: rare experts activated rarely, so their weights/activations are less represented in calibration data; quantization statistics dominated by common experts; also router logits for rare experts have low magnitude/confidence, small perturbations flip routing.
